entities.summary: Gyeongheung Eo clan was one of the Korean clans. Their Bon-gwan was located in Kyonghung County, North Hamgyong Province. According to research in 2000, the number people within the Gyeongheung Eo clan was 542. Their founder was Eo Gye bok. He was a grandchild of Eo Seok gyu and served as the Menxia Shilang in Ming dynasty. He immigrated to Kyonghung and began the Gyeongheung Eo clan.
